title: Successor-pair audit of the LLM leaderboard

scope.score: g = 50 + 15*theta from lib/score.ts fit; pm as reported
scope.significant: older g - newer g > sqrt(pm_old^2 + pm_new^2)
scope.h2h: per shared series key (same bench@evaluator cell), comparing latent y; err/Elo/linear handled by toLatent so higher is better
scope.pair_selection: Candidates generated from provider + name stem + size/tier tokens (scripts/candidates.py in scratch), then pruned and extended by hand. Kinds: successor, snapshot, ga (GA vs its preview/exp), near-size (clear lineup successor, size differs <~25%), base-chat (chat/instruct tune vs base weights, 'new' = chat).

method_patterns.name: Weak bridges between test clusters (cause b)
method_patterns.count: 33 of 53 inversions carry b; 10 inversions have no shared test at all (6 of them significant)
method_patterns.mechanism: Base models live in zero-shot commonsense/paper tables, chat models in arena and modern evals, previews in 2025 suites and GAs in 2026 agentic/math suites. Only a few series tie these clusters together, so the offset between clusters floats.
method_patterns.magnitude: Base cluster: applying the documented chance levels moves base models +4.4 to +6.1 while chat models do not move. Removing the single Tulu-2 paper bridge widens Llama 2 7B base vs chat from -9.5 to -18.7. Gemini 2.5 Pro GA is 4.1 below its 06-05 preview while winning their only shared test; merging the three preview ids into the GA gives 65.6.

method_patterns.name: Lab-only small series (self-report + tiny n)
method_patterns.count: 251 of the 299 non-primary series with n<=5 contain models from a single provider. 35 models get >30% of their weight from them.
method_patterns.mechanism: With n=3-5 the a/d of the series are not identified (a stays near its prior of 1). The series only encode the lab's own within-family spread, but they still add weight and shrink +-. With a~1, a one-logit gap is a full SD (15 g), versus about 5 g in a well-estimated frontier series (a~3).
method_patterns.magnitude: DeepSeek V3.1 66.5 -> 63.5 without its own card, which removes 3 inversions (V3.1 -> Terminus, V3.2-Exp, V3.2). Granite 4.2 8B +2.6 from IBM's card. LLaMA 65B and LLaMA 13B take 99% of their weight from the LLaMA paper's n=4 series. Mixtral and Mistral 7B base gaps fall from -6.0 to +0.3 and from -12.8 to -3.3 without Mistral's papers.

method_patterns.name: Floor clamp at 0.005
method_patterns.count: 99 floor-clamped cells in the main set (46 Epoch chess, 15 mystery games, 10 GPQA at or below chance, 3 FrontierMath T4 zeros)
method_patterns.mechanism: A 0 (or 1 of 285) is treated as an exact logit of -5.29. Every floored model gets the same implied g for that test (FM-T4 58.5, FM 47.4, chess 43.3, GPQA 26.6), which pulls strong models down and weak ones up. On high-a tests one item swings the result a lot.
method_patterns.magnitude: GPT-4o 08-06: one FrontierMath result at 1/285 (10% weight) costs 1.0 g and causes a significant inversion despite a 14-6 head-to-head. Without it the two snapshots tie (56.34 vs 56.39). Gemini 2.5 Pro: FM-T4 0/41 -> 1/41 moves that part from 58.5 to 63.7 and g by +0.58.

method_patterns.name: Text arena compresses at the top
method_patterns.count: Dropping text arena everywhere flips 5 frontier inversions: GPT-6 Sol, GPT-6 Luna, Grok 4.7, Muse Spark 1.1 and Gemini 3.6 Flash.
method_patterns.mechanism: Implied g from lmarena-text (a=0.72, sigma=0.13) is unbiased for models below 75 (mean residual -1.6 to +1.8 per 5-point band) but is -3.9 for models whose other evidence puts them at 75-80 (n=10) and -8.8 above 80 (n=3). GPQA shows the same at 75+ (-4.8, n=7). New frontier releases usually have arena plus only 3-5 other results, so arena gets 16-19% of their weight.
method_patterns.magnitude: GPT-6 Sol: text arena implies 70.5 against 78.6-81.6 from its other results. Without text arena GPT-6 Sol 79.95 vs GPT-5.6 Sol 78.94 (flips). Grok 4.7 74.73 vs 4.6 74.57 (flips). GPT-6 Luna -0.09 (near tie).

method_patterns.name: WebDev bottom-of-range and thinking-mode mismatch
method_patterns.mechanism: The WebDev series (n=115) has no weak models (lowest 1075.8), so low ratings extrapolate to about 58-62 whatever the model. Arena entries also mix thinking and non-thinking modes across snapshots of one family.
method_patterns.magnitude: Granite 4.1 8B WebDev 1190.3 implies 58.5 against 52.1 from its text arena (62% of its weight); without it the inversion goes away. Grok 4.1 WebDev 1213.8 (961 votes) implies 59.5 against 71.4 from text; without it 70.8 > 64.7. DeepSeek V3.2-Exp has only a non-thinking WebDev entry (1271.8), while V3.2 uses its thinking entry (1361.7; non-thinking 1324.8).

method_patterns.name: Thin evidence
method_patterns.count: 21 of 53 inversions involve a model with n<=2. 6 are significant: 4 base-chat, GPT-5.3 Chat and Granite 4.1 8B.
method_patterns.mechanism: Arena-only entries (n=1, +-2.7-3.0) and one-result models are compared with broadly tested siblings.
method_patterns.magnitude: ERNIE 5.0 previews, Grok 3 Preview, Qwen3-Max-Preview and DeepSeek V3.1 Terminus are all n=1. None of their inversions is significant.
